## Review checklist

- [ ] I described what I tested and what remains unproved.
- [ ] Game-source work starts naturally, with purpose headers/useful comments;
      matching-only shapes are explained and counted.
- [ ] No compiler flags were tuned for an individual game function.
- [ ] I retained the attempt/stuck history and did not conceal assembly fallback.
- [ ] No game images/assets/code dumps, original disassembly, proprietary tools,
      keys, private evidence, credentials, personal paths or saves are included.
- [ ] This stays within the reviewed bucket and preserves matching before porting.
